move: typed prompt, tiles shimmer in, words stream, code lines type out
how: A window rises in from y:40 scale 0.96 with expo.out. Feature 1 (0.05-0.36D): a prompt types via TextPlugin over 1s with a steps(1) blinking cursor, the send button squashes, then three image tiles fade/scale in with expo.out stagger 0.12 while a shimmer strip sweeps xPercent -100→100 across each; the block lifts out with power2.in. Feature 2 (0.4-0.67D): a paragraph's words fade up one by one (opacity/y:8, stagger 0.07) and two buttons appear, the primary one pulsing. Feature 3 (0.7-0.94D): seven code lines grow from width 0 to 100% with power1.inOut stagger 0.16. The window drops back out with power2.in and the title fades so the loop restarts empty.
adapt: Change the three feature headings, the typed prompt string, the paragraph sentence, the code lines and the window title; keep the 1s typing, 0.12 tile stagger and 0.16 code-line stagger.
port: mount(el, shot) builds .win with three .feat blocks and generates .para word spans from shot.sentence; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with feature windows at fractions of D (0.5/10, 3.95/10, 7.05/10, exit 9.55/10). Needs TextPlugin registered; scope selectors to el.
caveats: TextPlugin required for the typed prompt
code lines animate width, which relayouts each frame
catalog says 13s but the file renders 10s
